title: CoverageFrame: reasoned absence over a bounded question space
description: A small LinkML schema family for typed reasoned absence over a declared, bounded question space: CoverageFrame core (CoverageFrame, FrameCell, CellStatusEnum, DarkCauseEnum), a provenance module (SearchProtocol, PopulationDefinition, positive controls), and a delta module (FrameDelta, CellTransition). Runs in production at sniff.world; schema IDs resolve under https://sniff.world/schema/. Licensing: the schemas and examples are CC0-1.0; the generator script and CI workflow are MIT (see LICENSE and LICENSE-CODE in the repository).
